title.zh: US authorities dismantle crypto scam network that stole tens of millions
title.en: US authorities dismantle crypto scam network that stole tens of millions

current_state.zh: Brooklyn prosecutors and the FBI seized 112 servers and shut down 241 websites linked to an Eastern European cryptocurrency investment scam that stole tens of millions of dollars from primarily Russian-speaking Americans, with no arrests made.
